deployment_models.php-fpm: harness cold mode: the framework boots per request (opcache retained, as with real FPM workers sharing bytecode). Models the application cost FPM pays per request; FPM worker management itself is not simulated.
deployment_models.roadrunner: harness warm mode: the framework boots once and serves many requests from a resident worker (RoadRunner/Octane/Swoole style).
